clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in the Deadmines, Miner Johnson wanders among the Defias laborers. He is a seasoned miner who oversees excavation ahead of the heavy machinery, though he appears only now and then.

Miner Johnson works among the laborers digging beneath the Deadmines for Edwin VanCleef's hidden fortress. He waits in an alcove to the left, before the shredders in the Mast Room. Stronger and more aggressive than the other miners, he can be hard to find as he wanders the tunnels.

Beneath Moonbrook, the Defias Brotherhood needs ore for weapons, reinforced shafts, and mechanical contraptions. Johnson and the other miners dig the mineral seams beneath Westfall. Anyone who enters his work area will find that he guards it fiercely.
